Test Scenario: Verify Total Units KPI against report table
Expected Result: Total Units KPI equals the number of unique vehicle/unit records represented by the report table for the selected filters.

Test Scenario: Verify Total Units KPI after changing vehicle filter
Expected Result: Total Units KPI updates and equals the number of unique records returned for the newly selected vehicle filter.

Test Scenario: Verify Total Units KPI after changing date range
Expected Result: Total Units KPI reflects the records applicable to the newly selected date range.

Test Scenario: Verify Ignition On KPI against table data
Expected Result: Ignition On KPI equals the count of report rows/vehicles whose underlying ignition status is On, according to the report's defined business rule.

Test Scenario: Verify Moving Units KPI against table data
Expected Result: Moving Units KPI equals the count of vehicles whose underlying movement/current-speed condition qualifies as Moving.

Test Scenario: Verify Stale/Offline KPI against table data
Expected Result: Stale/Offline KPI equals the count of vehicles classified as Stale/Offline by the report's defined status/last-contact rule.

Test Scenario: Verify Avg Utilization KPI against report data
Expected Result: Avg Utilization KPI equals the calculated average utilization for the records returned by the report, using the application's defined calculation/rounding rule.

Test Scenario: Verify Active Alerts KPI against alert data
Expected Result: Active Alerts KPI equals the number of active alerts represented by the report/alert data source for the selected scope.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI rounding/decimal precision
Expected Result: KPI values use the same rounding and decimal precision defined by the application.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after pagination
Expected Result: Changing table page does not change KPIs; KPIs represent the complete filtered dataset rather than only the current page.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values with 10 rows per page
Expected Result: KPIs remain calculated from the full result set when table displays 10 rows per page.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after changing rows per page
Expected Result: Changing rows per page does not change KPI values.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after sorting a table column
Expected Result: Sorting table data does not change KPI values.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after searching/filtering report table
Expected Result: KPIs follow the application's defined behavior for table search; if search is a dataset filter, KPIs must update to match the filtered dataset.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values when all table records are visible
Expected Result: Each KPI can be independently reconciled against the corresponding complete dataset.

Test Scenario: Generate report with no records
Expected Result: KPIs display the defined zero/empty state and table shows no records.

Test Scenario: Generate report with exactly one record
Expected Result: All applicable KPIs are calculated correctly for a single record.

Test Scenario: Generate report where all vehicles are Moving
Expected Result: Moving Units equals Total Units and other status KPIs remain consistent.

Test Scenario: Generate report where no vehicles are Moving
Expected Result: Moving Units equals zero and table data contains no records meeting the Moving condition.

Test Scenario: Generate report where all vehicles are Stale/Offline
Expected Result: Stale/Offline KPI equals Total Units when all records meet the configured stale/offline condition.

Test Scenario: Generate report with zero active alerts
Expected Result: Active Alerts KPI displays zero and alert-related data is consistent with the empty state.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI does not retain values from previous report
Expected Result: After changing report type/filters and generating a new report, KPI cards reflect only the new report data.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI does not update from stale API response
Expected Result: A delayed response from an earlier request must not overwrite KPI values belonging to the latest report request.

Test Scenario: Report table loads but KPI API fails
Expected Result: Application shows an appropriate KPI error/empty state and does not display misleading stale KPI values.

Test Scenario: KPI loads but report table API fails
Expected Result: Application handles the inconsistent state clearly and does not present KPI/table values as successfully reconciled.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after report regeneration
Expected Result: Regenerating the same report produces KPI values consistent with the newly returned table dataset.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values for each Standard report that exposes KPI cards
Expected Result: Every KPI card exposed for the selected standard report is reconciled against its corresponding report data/source.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values for Custom report
Expected Result: Custom report KPIs correspond to the combined/custom dataset and do not use unrelated standard-report values.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after vehicle selection changes
Expected Result: Changing selected vehicles and regenerating updates all applicable KPI cards consistently.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after date/time filter changes
Expected Result: Changing date/time filters and regenerating updates all applicable KPIs consistently with returned data.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI calculation with negative/zero numeric report values where supported
Expected Result: KPI calculations follow the application's business rules and do not produce invalid values such as NaN or unexpected negative totals.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI calculation with missing/null source values
Expected Result: Null/missing source values are handled according to the defined calculation rule and do not corrupt KPI results.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI values after export/download
Expected Result: Where exported report contains the underlying KPI/source data, exported values match the displayed KPI values.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI card labels map to correct table fields
Expected Result: Each KPI is calculated from the intended business field and is not accidentally mapped to another table column.

Test Scenario: Verify KPI count uses unique vehicles when required
Expected Result: KPI counts unique vehicle/unit identifiers and does not double-count duplicate rows where the report can contain multiple records per vehicle.
